_note: Hand-coded scoring overlay for this PhenX scale. The PhenX REDCap converter does not produce scoring automatically. After rebuilding the .osd from a new PhenX export, run tools/apply_phenx_scoring.py to merge these dimensions and scoring blocks back into the generated .osd file.

stimulation.description: Stimulation subscale: sum of 7 items (Elated, Energized, Excited, Stimulated, Talkative, Up, Vigorous).

sedation.description: Sedation subscale: sum of 7 items (Difficulty concentrating, Down, Heavy head, Inactive, Sedated, Slow thoughts, Sluggish).
